name: Gravatar profiles
tier_rationale: Established company (Automattic) with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8): 'Gravatar (Automattic): tier trusted, terms open.' (P087 rationale).

reliability.justification: Authoritative for the profiles it hosts; profile content is self-asserted by the account owner, so identity links stay PROBABLE (verified accounts) or POSSIBLE (free-text links), P087 cond 4.

gravatar.description: Gravatar API key (optional; raises the Profiles API limit from 100 to 1000 requests per hour)
gravatar.plan_hint: free key from the Gravatar Developer Dashboard on an account created under the corporate identity; the API is free to use (terms open) and the key only raises limits: P087 keeps only display name, verified-account URLs and avatar hash whatever the key returns

profiles.title: Gravatar v3 profiles API (e-mail hash or username), legacy {u}.json and avatar existence d=404
profiles.notes: Research C0202 terms 'Gravatar/Automattic API terms' / 'Gravatar (Automattic) API ToS.' Endpoints api.gravatar.com/v3/profiles/{sha256(lower(trim(email)))} (hash computed locally, P087 cond 1), legacy en.gravatar.com/{username}.json, avatar existence gravatar.com/avatar/{hash}?d=404. A 404 {'error':'Profile not found'} is a declared absence handled by the module (P087 cond 3). E-mail hashes are dictionary-reversible personal data (PERSONAL_TYPES): personal_data_review must be recorded before default use (P087 cond 2). Used by gravatar and username_check.

notes: Seeded once for batches p1-G05-2 and p2-G04-1 (P087, P113). Quota: the Gravatar REST API documentation publishes 'Unauthenticated requests are limited to 100 per hour. Authenticated requests are limited to 1000 per hour.' (checked 2026-11-26); the block uses the keyless figure (budget 80/h per egress IP), also when the optional key is set; 429 = RATE_LIMITED (P087 cond 3). Not a people-data provider: flags.sensitive false.
